description: Generate exact-pinned Astro static/Node LTS/TypeScript scaffold with MDX support, commit project-local pnpm manifest/lockfile, ignores, and matching starter.json. This covers task 5.1.
steps: Create astro-adsense-blog/ directory at repository root
Initialize an Astro project with TypeScript strict mode, using `create astro` or equivalent scaffold at an exact pinned version. Use Astro 5.x stable (latest exact pin).
Add MDX integration (@astrojs/mdx) and sitemap integration (@astrojs/sitemap) as exact-pinned dependencies
Configure pnpm as package manager with packageManager field pinned to 10.28.1
Add astro.config.mjs with static output mode, MDX and sitemap integrations enabled

Create starter.json matching catalog entry #37 exactly: id=37, folder='astro-adsense-blog', family='Content/AdSense', useCase='Niche blog', framework='Astro', runtime='Node LTS', technologies=['TypeScript','MDX','content collections','AdSense','analytics','RSS'], auth='None', data='MDX content collections', monetization='AdSense', integrations=['analytics','RSS']
Run pnpm install to generate pnpm-lock.yaml
Verify the project builds with `pnpm astro build` (empty build is fine at this stage)
acceptance_criteria: astro-adsense-blog/package.json exists with exact-pinned Astro and integration dependencies
astro-adsense-blog/starter.json matches catalog entry #37 fields exactly
astro-adsense-blog/.gitignore excludes node_modules, dist, .astro, env files (except .env.example)
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile succeeds from the astro-adsense-blog directory
pnpm astro build succeeds (even if producing empty output)
findings: Used astro@5.18.2, @astrojs/mdx@4.3.14, @astrojs/sitemap@3.7.3, typescript@5.8.3, @astrojs/check@0.9.10. Added site: 'https://example.com' in astro.config.mjs to allow sitemap generation without warning. pnpm shows deprecated subdep warning (tsconfck@3.1.6) and ignored build scripts warning for esbuild/sharp - both are harmless. Build and frozen-lockfile install both pass.
